facts.fact: ANIP says nearly 13.8 million people are enrolled in the RNPP, the national population register, as at 6 May 2026.
ANIP says a birth declaration enters the person in the RNPP and a death automatically updates the RNPP.
ANIP says the RNPP is the only source for identity cards, passports and driving licences, and that phone SIM acquisition and public service platforms authenticate against the NPI.
